tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Barka da zuwa, shugaba. Ni ne Malam Hoshi. Danginmu sun sami wani kwari ɓoyayye a cikin duwatsu. Mu gina ƙauyen da babu abokin hamayya da zai iya gano shi.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Masana'antar Kuɗinku tana ƙera Kuɗi. Idan tsaba ta bayyana a samanta, ku taɓa ta, sannan Karɓa.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Dangi na tafiya ne da Kuɗi. Ku taɓa Gina ku sanya Masana'antar Kuɗi.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Yanzu ku ƙarfafa Hasumiyar Dangi: ku taɓa gidan sarauta, sannan Inganta.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Ingantawa na ɗaukar lokaci. Hasumiya za ta kammala cikin {time}: ku dawo a lokacin, ko ku taɓa Gama yanzu don amfani da ɗan Jed.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Dangogin abokan hamayya za su kawo mana hari. Ku gina Hasumiyar Kunai kusa da Hasumiya (Gina, sannan shafin Tsaro): tana harbin duk mai kai hari da ke kusa.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Ku gina Dojon Horo, Farfajiyar Tawaga da Hasumiyar Kunai kusa da Hasumiya (Gina: shafin Runduna, sannan shafin Tsaro).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Ku buɗe allon Runduna ku horar da wasu Shinobi: masu takobi masu sauri da ke sara ginin da ya fi kusa.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Horo ma na ɗaukar lokaci: mayaƙanku za su shirya cikin {time}. Ku jira, ko ku taɓa Gama horo don amfani da ɗan Jed.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Harinku na farko. Ku taɓa Kai hari, ku duba abin da za ku kai wa hari, sannan Kai hari! A filin daga zan nuna muku abu ɗaya bayan ɗaya: ku tura Shinobi ta wani wuri mai haske, sannan ku rufe su da hayaƙi idan sun isa hasumiya: mayaƙan da ke cikin hayaƙi ba a iya harbinsu sai daga kusa.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: An yi yaƙi da kyau. Ku inganta Dojon Horo don buɗe Masu Zagon Ƙasa: suna tsayar da ginin tsaro na 'yan daƙiƙoƙi. Ku fara tsayarwa, sannan ku kai bugu, ku rufe mayaƙanku da hayaƙi inda wuta ta fi zafi. Ku karɓa, ku inganta, ku kai hari, ku shiga Ƙawance.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Lada ɗaya a kowace rana, iri ɗaya ga kowa, ba na sa'a ba kuma ba a sayar da shi. Idan kun rasa wata rana babu abin da zai ɓace: karɓa ta gaba ita ce rana ta gaba a jerin. Rana ta 28 tana ba da kamannin Hasumiya.

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Tayi na musamman ba sa fitowa ga 'yan wasa 'yan ƙasa da shekara 18. Duk abin da ke shafin Jed yana nan a cikin iyakar kashe kuɗinku.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Isarwa tana farawa nan take: ana iya karɓar biya na farko yanzu, ɗaya kuma a kowace rana; ta hanyar saya kun yarda cewa kun rasa damar soke sayen, kamar yadda doka ta ba da dama ga abubuwan dijital.

store.error.cancelled.text: An soke sayayya. Ba a cire kuɗi ba.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Ba a iya saya a yanzu. Ku sake gwadawa nan gaba.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Sayayyar ba ta yi nasara ba. Idan an cire muku kuɗi, za a isar da ita da zarar shagon ya tabbatar.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Ku tsara kowane gini na {building} lokaci ɗaya. Nisa yana harbi mai nisa amma da ƙarancin ƙarfi kuma yana fara kai wa mayaƙan baya; Fashewa yana bugun gungun mayaƙa amma yana harbi a hankali; Tsaro yana ƙara ƙarfin Hasumiyar Bakan Sama, Kaskon Hayaƙi Mai Ɗaci da tarkuna. Masu kai hari suna ganin tsarin idan sun yi leƙen asiri.
